purpose: Single explicit cast selection with mandatory evidence. Six cold text preparations over three retained refusal-heavy verses. No production access or images.
authorization: Owner said ok continue. Uses only the existing evaluation allowance; no increase or transfer from preparation/smoke.
method: Candidate only, interleaved by repeat then sample. Fresh memory store for each operation with ordinary look invalidation, production adapter/settings, malformed retry and one re-plan. Uses the exact retained source/cast records from the v6 paired sample. All first outcomes retained; no tuning or rerun once frozen.

acceptance.diagnostic: All six operations complete without unavailable review or uncertain usage; at least four acceptable stored scenes, zero flawed or uncertain stores. Refusals are not repairs. Structural contradictions are impossible in a schema-valid new response; their absence alone does not prove semantic improvement.
acceptance.scoring: Unblinded operator scores every stored field against source/cast, explicitly retaining ambiguous or subjective calls. Offline replay verifies mechanics, not semantic verdicts.
acceptance.release: This selected six-run diagnostic cannot establish population improvement or satisfy the failed 21-run pipeline gate. Broader ordinary/hard-moment text checks, image comparison and current full-request latency still need evidence before human release acceptance.

retryPolicy: One-shot. Reserve before every actual request. Stop on unknown cost, provider error, request drift, unavailable review or cap. No operation starts without $0.010 headroom; no new sample after a stop. No extra retries beyond ordinary preparation behavior.
audit: Commit source, protocol, fixture hashes and first-request dry-run hashes before paid calls. Record the exact frozen commit. Fresh provider pricing and balance preflight. Replay all requests/results offline and verify per-call costs against the ledger; account balance is shared with unrelated live traffic.
